title: the frontmatter of .kit/rules/<kind>.md and .kit/styles/<kind>.md
description: What a rule or a style governs and runs: the kinds it names, the linter and the checks kit lint runs over their files, and the templates that hold their shape. Each key is described in docs/context.md.

lint.description: The linter command kit lint runs once over the files of the kinds.

items.description: One of the kit's own checks, by name.

templates.description: The shapes a file of the kinds takes, in the order they are tried; a style's key.

path.description: A glob that limits the template to the paths it matches.

executable.description: When true, kit new file makes the file executable.
